notes: New tab Captions (instead of Words): one card = one caption exactly as on screen (same layout as the render). Enter = new line in the caption, Shift+Enter = split into two captions, ⊕ = merge with the next (or why it can't), right-click: ✦ highlight words · ✎ this caption's style · 🎨 from a preset · ↺ as everyone · ▶; click a word = playhead, [ / ] = word start / end. The cheat-sheet sits in the empty space right of the picture (or folded in the list). Sentences is now the VOICE tab only (▶ 🎙 👄 📅 ✂). Text tab: «|» = a new line inside the caption. Fix: typing a full stop in a Sentences row (a new sentence) and then editing / pressing Enter duplicated words («challenge. challenge. challenge.») and could drop the next sentence. Rows now rebuild the text from what they were drawn from. Sentences: right-click a sentence (or the words you selected) → ✦ Accent · ✎ Стиль цього речення · 🎨 Почати з пресету · ↺ Як у всіх · ↵ new line · ▶ · 🎙 · ✂. ✎ Sentence style: the Style tab edits ONLY that sentence (purple banner + row; ✓ Готово / Esc to leave) — it keeps just what you changed, so later changes to the caption style still reach it; a sentence from a preset follows edits to that preset and keeps the caption's position. 💾 «Зберегти в «preset»» appears when you've changed the preset you're on (and in its right-click menu) — no more duplicate → rename. ⬇ MRTech JSON: two exports — only their 13 keys (works as is) or + an x_assembler block (case, layout, plate modes / shadow, double stroke, shadows / glow, scrim, karaoke). ⬇ MRTech JSON: right-click any caption preset → its style in MRTech's caption format (font, color, bg_color, fontsize, margins, stroke, corner_radius) + our extras (case, lines, chars / words per line, punctuation, plate mode / padding / opacity, shadow, karaoke). Two clear ways to change words. 🎙 ElevenLabs re-voice → 👄 «Губи під озвучку» (Sync Lipsync-2-Pro via WaveSpeed, ~$0.08/s): only the mouth is re-animated, the picture isn't repainted — in Sentences after a re-voice, and the default in 📅 Dates. ✨ Seedance changes the SOUND and the picture together: «Keep original audio» is now OFF by default; in 📅 Dates «✨ Seedance: звук і картинка» lets Seedance say the new date itself (2.5 Turbo / Flash / 2.5 / 2.0, 📐 medium shot). Every result lands on ✨ Generated (switch on / off). Sentences: Enter = ↵ a new LINE inside the same caption (blue ↵ in the row; Enter on the same spot removes it; Cmd+Enter = done). Words: Enter stays «new caption». Clicking a word in Sentences moves the playhead there. A click on the timeline / the picture takes the caret out of the text, so Space plays instead of typing a space. ✨ Generated layer: Seedance pieces sit on their own lane «✨ Generated» under Picture (purple) and as a purple strip on the picture — click a piece to switch it off (original picture back) or on; 👁 = all off / all on to compare; right-click — ▶ watch the piece. 📅 Dates: newest models — Seedance 2.5 Turbo (default), 2.5 Flash Turbo (cheaper, 480p upscaled), full 2.5, 2.0 Fast Turbo. 📐 «середній план мовця»: Seedance reframes the piece into a medium close-up of the speaker, like a new camera angle — a wide two-shot hides the patch badly. Words view highlights dates (yellow) and ✦ accent words too, like Sentences. ✦ Accent is now a full style of its own: Style → ✦ Accent — colour or gradient, any font, italic, size 80–160 %, case, stroke (as the caption / own / none), shadow (as the caption / own / none), a plate under the word. «Взяти вигляд з…» borrows a preset's look (font, colours, stroke, shadow, plate) without its size, position or case. The caption keeps its own layout; karaoke never repaints an accent word; the accent is saved with the preset. In Sentences the second button is now «🎨 Окремий титр» — a phrase as its own caption in another preset.
